description: Human-facing metadata for hooks/hooks.json. Claude Code (>= 2.1.267) warns about any key other than "matcher" and "hooks" on a hook group, so hook ids and descriptions live here instead. "match" is a substring that identifies the group's command uniquely within its event; tests/hooks/hooks.test.js keeps this file in sync with hooks.json.
